Alyssa (AE): Hey team — FinCorp POC is asking for a concrete throughput/commit recommendation so legal can finish the pricing T&Cs. They gave a target: 250 req/s peak, 40 tokens avg per response, want p95 gen <250ms. They also asked if we can guarantee reserved capacity + burst credits. Security has flagged the questionnaire and it’s blocking signature. Need a size + example autoscale policy to include in the SOW.

Tara (Solutions): OK. Quick calc: 250 * 40 = 10k tokens/s peak. With our perf numbers on MPT-style models at 8-bit quant, a high-util GPU does ~2.5k tokens/s steady on long sequences, but burst-friendly profiles can push more. Recommend reserved baseline: 4 GPUs (reserved) + burst pool (shared) for spikes. That gives ~10k tokens/s steady with some headroom.

Jeff (SalesEng): Pricing note — 6-month reserved commit at that level maps to our "Reserved-4" SKU. We can include a 20% burst credit bucket for sudden surges (consumed before extra overage billing). If they want stronger latency SLAs, call out a prewarm-runway and can add a small hourly prewarm fee.

Mike (SRE): Operational caution: AZ affinity and warm KV cache are important. If we scale from 1 -> 4 replicas cold, first requests will see KV coldstart; recommend warm standby replica(s) pinned to the primary AZ for <250ms p95. Also suggest these autoscale knobs:

```yaml
min_replicas: 1
warm_replicas: 1    # pinned, always warm
max_replicas: 6
scale_policy:
  target_tokens_per_gpu: 2000  # scale up when tokens/s per GPU > 2000
  cooldown_seconds: 45
  scale_step: 1
burst_pool: true
```

Tara (Solutions): That policy above is what I'd include in the SOW appendix. For model choice, call out a compatible faster-serve variant (quantized) with fallback to a higher-capacity model if latency degrades. Add a line: "Automatic fallback to compatible model variant in other region if reserved pool is saturated."

Anika (Security): From the questionnaire side, they want confirmation on KMS/HSM for keys, audit logs retention, and whether we can do private VPC for Dedicated. I can provide the security artifact but need the SSO contact + expected data retention window. Also they asked about data isolation for burst pool — clarify that burst runs on isolated tenant slices, not shared model weights.

Jeff (SalesEng): For the SOW wording I’d add two optional lines they can tick: (1) AZ-affinity hard pin (extra fee) and (2) guaranteed burst credits (prepaid). That helps convert this into a commit vs just a best-effort.

Alyssa (AE): This is great. Action items: Tara — paste the autoscale snippet and model fallback language into the SOW appendix. Jeff — add the Reserved-4 pricing + burst credit checkbox. Anika — send security artifact and one-paragraph on burst isolation so FinCorp can mark the questionnaire done. Mike — note the warm-replica requirement in the ops runbook. I’ll loop in FinCorp legal after we have the SOW draft.

ops-bot: reminder set for 2 business days to follow up on SOW draft.

Tara (Solutions): Will do, I’ll drop the SOW appendix in the deal doc by EOD.

Jeff (SalesEng): I’ll sketch the pricing options and three commit tiers so finance can sign off.

Anika (Security): Will attach the security checklist and propose KMS integration steps. If they need an HSM attestation, flag here and I'll escalate.

Mike (SRE): I’ll add a short note on warm cache ops and prewarm runbook snippets.

Alyssa (AE): Thanks team — I’ll update FinCorp with the timeline and ask legal to standby for the updated SOW.
